question: Should existing GitHub-backed skills with over-limit stored display names be grandfathered like hosted skills, or intentionally renamed on their next sync?
rationale: The PR's code can enforce a limit, but the upgrade behavior changes existing catalog metadata and cannot be chosen safely from tests alone.

options.title: Grandfather GitHub-backed legacy names
options.body: Preserve unchanged existing over-limit GitHub-backed titles and enforce the 40-character limit only for new or renamed values.

options.title: Accept sync-time renames
options.body: Allow next sync to normalize existing over-limit GitHub-backed titles, but document that migration behavior and cover it with focused tests/proof.

options.title: Pause for display-name policy
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers confirm the maximum length and legacy handling in the linked issue or PR discussion.

recommendation.title: Grandfather GitHub-backed legacy names
recommendation.body: Preserve unchanged existing over-limit GitHub-backed titles and enforce the 40-character limit only for new or renamed values.
